detail: AI Agent-related prompt repositories, Awesome lists, tutorials and research collections may enter the candidate pool; label content type and retain normal evidence, licensing and authenticity thresholds
Content projects may occupy at most one of the three daily primary recommendation slots; additional high-quality content projects should appear after the primary three as extra discoveries
Every extra discovery must include a weighted score and the same ten evidence fields as primary recommendations, interpreted appropriately for its content type
Weekly selection must consider both daily primary recommendations and extra discoveries on equal eligibility, then re-verify and select at most five projects
User said alibaba/open-code-review is also a good project; treat as positive feedback for weekly selection and close-quality candidate tie breaks
